capabilities.thickness_note: FR-4 thicknesses; 0.4-4.5 mm overall, 2.5 mm and above for 12+ layer PCBs only
capabilities.materials_note: FR-4 grade A laminates (Nan Ya, KB, Shengyi); impedance results assume NP-155F for 4-8 layers and S1000-2M for 10+ layers; select FR-4 TG155 when ordering 4/6-layer impedance builds (gsuberland README, unverified)

rf.note: 1 oz, 2-layer RF PCBs with Rogers and PTFE cores; the finished thicknesses are not mapped to core thicknesses by JLC (unverified)

capabilities.hybrid_note: no RO4350B/FR-4 hybrid is offered (a 2025-11-30 user question has no JLC answer)

soldermask.published: C1 1.2 mil over substrate, C2 0.6 mil over trace, C3 1.2 mil between traces, CEr 3.8 (0.03048 / 0.01524 / 0.03048 mm, rounded as in ADR D7.1)

default_templates.note: ADR D7.2.4: 1-2 layers generic:2L-1.6; 4L JLC04161H-7628; 6L JLC06161H-2116; otherwise the snapshot's no-requirement (NOREQ) template of that count, nearest thickness, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner preferred
